name: Staged: VIHALS set for six in the open corner, a floating BESTÅ buffet and art on the bottom wall
notes:
The top side is open to the living room (Andrew, 2026-10-24) as well as the left side to the kitchen, so both 30-inch walkways stay clear (F-42): every floor piece stands at x 30 or more and y 30 or more, nothing hangs on either open side, and rugs run under the walkways.
Staged pick: the VIHALS / VIHALS white set for six (five VIHALS chairs and Maddie's URBAN), table closed and turned across the room (long side along the 128" walls), the one way its six seats fit: along the depth the bottom end would keep only 23.3" to the wall. The table sits in the open corner: its kitchen-end chair and its two living-room-side chairs stand just inside the walkways, so the walkways are the passing space behind them (F-36: 48.5" from the left end to the kitchen line, 53.9" from the top edge to the living-room line).
F-36 to the walls: 36" from the bottom edge to the bottom wall (the BESTÅ floats above the chairs' backs, so it is measured to the wall), 32.25" from the right end to the right wall (tight:32.3, Maddie's end: a parent pushes the URBAN in). Leaf in (70 7/8"), the table opens 11.8" at each end: 20.4" from its right end to the wall (tight:20.4), and the kitchen-end chair stands 11.8" into the walkway while the guests are over, so the leaf is for an occasional evening.
The view: from the living room you look across the table to the BLODFLÄDER over the buffet; from the kitchen, along the table to the bird of paradise in the far corner.
Audit 2026-10-24 (from the rug-free E): the wall lamps moved 1.4" outward (lamp-1 to x 39.1, lamp-2 to x 98.2), each centered between the canvas and the buffet's end; at 1" from the frame they crowded the canvas. Guest evenings with the leaf in seat three to a side, both ends empty, so no chair stands in the kitchen walkway; the HAVSRIS cord drop goes in a cord cover, never across an open side or behind Maddie's seat.

placements.note: VIHALS extendable, closed 47 1/4 x 29 1/8", across the room; F-36: 48.5" to the kitchen line and 53.9" to the living-room line (passing sides), 36" to the bottom wall, 32.25" to the right wall (tight:32.3); leaf in, 20.4" (tight:20.4)
living-room side, left; its back 5.4" inside the walkway's edge (F-42)
bottom side, left; 17.5" behind it to the wall, and its back slides under the floating buffet
kitchen end; its back on the walkway's edge (x 30); pulled out it borrows the walkway (F-36 passing side)
Maddie's URBAN at the right end, the sixth seat; 13.4" behind it to the wall (the tight end: a parent pushes her in)

BESTÅ wall-mounted cabinet, 8 5/8" deep, centered on the table on the bottom wall and floated as a buffet with its underside about 33" up (top about 48"), above the chairs' 31 1/8" backs; push-open doors, on its suspension rails into studs (F-63)
BLODFLÄDER centered above the buffet, about 54 to 85 1/2" up: the focal point from the living room
VARPTROSS above the buffet's left end, center about 60" up, plug-in, cord in a cover
VARPTROSS above the buffet's right end; as lamp-1
GULLSUDARE on the HAVSRIS swag cord, hooked over the table's center (72.1, 68.4)
FEJKA bird of paradise in the bottom-right corner, the far corner from both openings, so it walls off nothing
LYDERSHOLM turned across, centered on the table's depth: 24.9" past each long side, 43.5" past the kitchen end, 27.25" past the right end; its left 25" under the kitchen walkway (F-42 allows rugs)

extras.note: HAVSRIS cord set for the pendant: a ceiling hook over the table's center, the 15'5" cord along the ceiling to an outlet (the ceiling box is unknown); E26 LED bulb not in the catalog
STOPP FILT anti-slip underlays under the LYDERSHOLM (its page: 'You will need 2 ... Trim if necessary'): on tile with a 4-year-old running, the rug must not slide
SVARTSENAP runner, natural cotton, machine washable
SVARTSENAP placemats, one per seat, machine washable (online minimum 4)
BLANDA MATT 11" bamboo bowl, the centerpiece (fruit), unbreakable
MALINDA chair pads, one per VIHALS chair (5), light beige cotton, the whole pad machine washable
